review.why: Directly demonstrates the November answers. No contrary evidence found; asking again is redundant. No live or first-touch certification.

decisions.speaker: conductor
decisions.text: Retain the existing working-crown ambient sound. It does not discharge individual calls from living birds, which thin with the actual population. The water warning hushes both, using the shared silence authority. Do not synthesize a chorus-level number or let an independent bird recording stand in for living calls. The October card contains no explicit owner reversal of the September population-dependent promise.
decisions.authority_limit: September quoted words and October card histories are documentary evidence, not newly recovered OWNER events. Sound separation and audibility remain unmeasured.

decisions.speaker: agent
decisions.text: One aquifer does not imply every consequence has the same scope. Preserve map-wide adult eye victory and the existing map-wide adult suppression service. Porter anger and the November escaped-young intervention attach to their particular pool. Shared Tenant strikes must respect applicable adult defeat/chemical quiet and pool provocation. BestiaryEnabled retains its explicit narrow scope over limbs and the drive-off ladder; it is not a master switch for shared water hazards. Reload must preserve active consequences and obligations.

decisions.speaker: agent

No directed borer-control promise is added. Broken lootable mirror-side hives remain distinct from live reactive inland dungeons. Dynamic branch-lane movement stays later; the dismissed density split stays discharged.

asks.text: Which core promise should define FeverWood: branch routes governing ordinary life above water with consequences, or a different experience missing from the recorded answers?
asks.decision: The stage-1 root wording; root approval is separate from selecting a flagship and certifying first touch.
asks.author: rm-role-designercodex-1794804230
asks.recommended_answer: Make a home on the branches, whose routes shape daily work and travel, above black water that remembers what you do and sometimes reaches up to change your plans.
asks.why_no_pause: The November OWNER event selects daily branch routes with occasional tentacle interruptions. The October documented experience supplies the remembering black water. Implementation gaps attack delivery of this promise, not the obvious choice of promise. No evidence yet found for replacing that experience.
asks.answer: Make a home on the branches, whose routes shape daily work and travel, above black water that remembers what you do and sometimes reaches up to change your plans.

asks.text: When birds leave the crown, which change should the player hear: their calls fade with them over the working crown ambience, or the bird chorus continues independently as part of that ambience?
asks.decision: Whether the living bird population audibly supplies the chorus alongside the already-built crown ambience, or whether the later build-first card superseded that population-dependent behavior.
asks.author: rm-role-designercodex-1794805981
asks.recommended_answer: Living birds supply their own calls; the built crown ambience remains alongside, and the water warning hushes both.
candidate_evidence_rebutted: September explicitly forbids a map-wide chorus and ties calls to living animals (fever_wood_deep_and_mud_2026-09-23.md:611). October row 0 explicitly includes bird calls in soundsAmbient, and the accepted build-first summary repeats crown ambient sound (feverwood_bedazzle_review_2026-10-02.md:296,520). This could be a later substitution, rather than an addition.

review.why: The actual October card asks for working crown sound while landing previously decided work. It never explicitly reverses population-dependent individual calls. The claimed substitution appears in agent implementation specifications and retrospective summaries. Both promises can be delivered alongside each other without putting built ambience up for removal. A new owner choice would be redundant.

asks.resolution: Never sent. Retain built crown ambience alongside individual living-bird calls; water-warning hush covers both. Individual calls and their hush remain delivery gaps, not accepted implementation.

Ordinary ambient rolls spawn feeler, snare, lash, porter or sentinel limbs, with a live cap and linger behavior. Damage starts retreat or severing, with flesh and respite consequences. Bloom is excluded from the ordinary weighted table.

An unmolested porter places loot and withdraws. Attacking it ends future porter rolls through a saved map-wide anger flag. Locality and increased pool hostility require correction against the documented porter consequences.

A qualifying large pool and accumulated encounter pressure can escalate into multiple limbs plus the eye. Eye damage accumulates during a withdrawal window, with moderate map-wide drive-off and severe map-wide permanent defeat.

The uranium suppressant, machining recipe, designator, workgiver and haul/dump job exist. The job checks feature state and surviving designation before consumption. Suppression updates map-wide clocks and optionally withdraws all limbs.

The meat-fed prison tank produces flesh, spleen chemicals and cream, teaches after successful product placement, and risks escape through damage or neglect. Current destruction routes spawn a breach-injured escapee on KillFinalize and quietly release on deconstruction. Older product-clock defaults are repaired lazily.

Only an armed tank escapee reaching registered water installs a tenant. Gaining a faction disarms installation. Current installation immediately clears the map-wide defeat flag and destroys the escapee.

root.text: Make a home on the branches, whose routes shape daily work and travel, above black water that remembers what you do and sometimes reaches up to change your plans.
root.speaker: conductor
root.interpretation: The branch-led daily-life and consequential-water promise. This wording is the delegated agent synthesis. It is not an owner quotation or a claim of delivered live behavior. It supplies no flagship pick or first-touch certification.

stage1_review.why: Implementation gaps challenge delivery of the root, not the root choice. The DRAFT walk and November card did not themselves approve this wording. The later Evidence-for-Ask ruling authorizes the separately recorded delegated call.

stage2_review.why: Full card context provides no owner reversal of individual living calls; promises coexist. November OWNER answers directly support branches_and_shore. No question sent.

second_review.why: Later tree-size/plant-economy rules deliberately leave the three plants harvest-free. Bestiary toggle stays narrow.
